title: ServiceNow powers actionable enterprise AI with OpenAI
summary: ServiceNow expands access to OpenAI frontier models to power AI-driven enterprise workflows, summarization, search, and voice across the ServiceNow Platform.
body: ServiceNow expands access to OpenAI frontier models to power AI-driven enterprise workflows, summarization, search, and voice across the ServiceNow Platform.
summaryZh: ServiceNow宣布扩展对OpenAI前沿模型的集成，旨在通过AI驱动的自动化能力优化企业工作流。此次合作将大模型能力引入搜索、语音交互及任务总结等核心功能，提升企业内部运营效率。该集成体现了AI Agent在企业级场景中从辅助工具向流程自动化核心的演进，通过将模型能力嵌入现有业务平台，实现更高效的业务处理与决策支持。

aiReview.reasonZh: 展示了前沿模型在企业级工作流自动化中的深度集成，是AI Agent落地的典型案例。
